Turn your AI coding assistant into an expert reverse engineer! 🔍🤖

Developers, have you ever hit a wall trying to understand a closed-source dependency, proprietary SDK, or legacy application with zero documentation? Manually navigating de-compilers like Ghidra can take days just to figure out how a single feature works. 

Meet REA: the tool that bridges Model Context Protocol (MCP) with deep binary and application analysis. It connects LLM-powered AI agents directly to heavy-hitting analysis tools so you can use natural language to investigate complex code.

✨ Key Features:
• Seamless MCP integration with AI agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI
• Native binary analysis backed by Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA
• Multi-target support for JavaScript, Electron apps, offline ELF layouts, Go/Rust binaries, WebAssembly, and EVM bytecode
• 100% local-first execution to keep your code investigation secure on your own machine

Whether you are auditing software supply chains or deconstructing how a third-party app implements a specific feature down to the assembly level, REA gathers concrete evidence and pseudocode for you in minutes instead of days.

Check it out on GitHub and start reverse engineering with AI today:
https://github.com/morluto/rea

Stop writing brittle custom glue code for AI apps and start orchestrating production-ready, self-hosted LLM agents and multi-step workflows visually. 🤖⚡

Building complex AI applications often means getting bogged down in writing endless custom API polling loops, authentication handlers, and LLM orchestration boilerplate. 

n8n (https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n) bridges the gap between traditional workflow automation and advanced AI application development. It gives developers a fair-code, self-hostable visual canvas paired with deep code execution control, letting you deploy automated pipelines connected to over 1,500 integrations without architectural vendor lock-in.

Here is why backend, AI/ML, and DevOps engineers are adding it to their stack:

🧠 AI-Native Agent Orchestration: Build multi-step AI agents with built-in memory, tool use, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
💻 Code When You Need It: Combine the visual node-based editor with custom JavaScript, Python, and npm packages for advanced data transformation.
🔌 Comprehensive Integrations: Connect easily to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or local open-source models while tapping into 1,500+ pre-built SaaS app integrations.
🔒 Enterprise-Ready Self-Hosting: Deploy securely on your own infrastructure via Docker with full data ownership, RBAC, and complete pipeline observability.

Save hundreds of hours on infrastructure boilerplate. Handle error logging, retries, and state management out of the box so you can focus entirely on business logic and prompt engineering.

Tired of sluggish, proprietary 3D CAD tools that lock your hardware designs behind expensive licenses and clunky interfaces? 

Meet SolidCraft (https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft): a pure Rust parametric 3D CAD application designed to bring deterministic performance and built-in AI agent automation straight to hardware engineering. 

SolidCraft completely eliminates the complexity and lock-in of legacy CAD by offering an open-source, cross-platform solid modeler. Whether you are sketching constraints locally or running in the browser via WebAssembly, your parametric feature timelines instantly rebuild the moment dimensions change.

Here is what makes SolidCraft a game-changer for software and hardware developers:

🤖 Built-in MCP Server: Leverage Model Context Protocol servers to let AI agents programmatically build and manipulate complex 3D models and multi-thousand step timelines.
⚡ High-Performance Constraint Solver: Combines exact locus intersections and rigid-cluster decomposition with Levenberg-Marquardt optimization for lightning-fast sketch solving.
🌐 Cross-Platform Rust & WASM: Memory-safe performance running natively on your desktop or seamlessly inside web applications without heavy dependencies.
🛠️ Full Parametric Timeline: Supports extrusions, revolves, sweeps, lofts, fillets, and patterns with incremental rebuilding and full undo-redo capabilities.

Use cases range from building AI-powered generative design pipelines where LLMs construct mechanical enclosures automatically, to embedding high-performance CAD viewers directly into web stacks.

Ready to hack the future of mechanical design? Star and clone the repository today:
👉 https://github.com/bherbruck/solidcraft

Transform your local terminal and desktop environment into an autonomous, multi-file software engineering workspace with OpenCode. 💻✨

Tired of the friction that comes with multi-file code generation, tedious refactoring, and managing complex workspaces manually? OpenCode is an open-source, terminal-based and desktop AI coding agent designed to seamlessly navigate your codebase, edit multiple files at once, and execute entire development workflows right where you work. 🚀

Here is why developers are adding it to their local stack:
🛡️ Dual-Mode Agent Switching: Easily toggle between a full-access build agent and a read-only plan agent for safe, risk-free code exploration.
🔍 Built-in General Subagent: Handle complex searches and multistep tasks effortlessly using simple inline tagging.
📦 Extensive Package Support: Enjoy cross-platform installation via CLI scripts, Homebrew, Scoop, and native desktop builds.

Whether you are refactoring large legacy codebases across multiple files simultaneously or onboarding onto a brand-new repository by leveraging the plan agent for secure architecture exploration, OpenCode accelerates your workflow without forcing you to leave your preferred environment. 

Ready to supercharge your local development? Check out the repo and get started today:
https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode

Tired of the constant friction of managing multiple AI development identities, browser environments, and system configurations? 

Meet CCBaga, a fast-rising Rust and Tauri desktop toolkit that automates Claude identity management, isolated browser fingerprinting, and environment verification across macOS, Linux, and Windows! 🚀

CCBaga solves the headache of context-switching by combining native OS settings control, isolated Chromium profile management, and encrypted identity vaulting into a single cross-platform desktop application. Perfect for AI engineers, international remote developers, and multi-account power users.

🔥 Notable Features:
• Dual-Application Architecture: CCBaga-A handles native operations while CCBaga-B manages isolated browser profiling on Rust and Tauri.
• Secure SQLite Vaults: Encrypted and compressed SQLite-backed .baga container storage for secure local archiving, switching, and recovery of Claude Code and Claude Desktop identities.
• Dynamic Fingerprint Rotation: Automated browser fingerprint seed rotation that dynamically matches system-level regional languages, timezones, and locales.
• AI-Guided Network Setup: Leverages Agent Skills specifications to integrate proxy configurations seamlessly with local coding assistants like Cursor, Copilot, and Codex.

Whether you are isolating and swapping multiple accounts safely during international travel or automating the verification of browser fingerprints before running local AI workflows, CCBaga gives you a reproducible, verifiable way to manage sandbox states without polluting your host system.

👉 Check out the repository and drop a star:
https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga
